mentions.name: IoT network provider middleware
mentions.description: An open source middleware for the Internet of Things that abstracts the various network providers behind a simple interface, filling a gap in the IoT open source software landscape.
mentions.problem: The IoT open source software landscape is missing a simple middleware to abstract the various network providers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I think that the IoT open source software landscape is missing a simple middleware to abstract the various network providers. I'm trying to fill that gap and hope to author a "show HN" soon about that :-)
